name: 大雨那天 · 人物传 VOL.8（陷阱猎人版）
desc: 2026 暑假特辑 SP9《大雨那天》陷阱猎人版语法命门 12 题，按 R / SR / SSR 三档标注难度。本卷的九宫格主图、看图与回读（13–17）、传记阅读（18–20）、对号入座、名册核对与密码显影依赖纸面图与原文，未进题库。

m5.q: Nobody stopped to rest that afternoon, ___ ?
m5.why: 陈述部分含 nobody 已是否定，反意部分用肯定；nobody 指人，附加问句用 they。

m5.q: The rain fell ___ hard that the path turned to mud in an hour.
m5.why: so + 副词/形容词 + that 从句——hard 在这里是副词。

m5.q: They ___ up the mountain since six this morning, and they are still walking.
m5.why: since + 时间点 + 到现在仍在继续 → 现在完成进行时。

m5.q: Jie is the one ___ clothes were wet through, but he never said a word.
m5.why: 横线后面是名词 clothes，缺的是「他的」，用关系代词 whose。

m5.q: That is the hut under ___ the cat was sitting, dry and quiet.
m5.why: 介词 + 关系代词，指物用 which——under which。

m5.q: The name ___ on the last line was not there a month ago.
m5.why: 过去分词作后置定语，表被动——名字是「被写上去的」。

m5.q: The harder it rained, ___ the three of them walked.
m5.why: the + 比较级, the + 比较级——两个分句都必须带 the。

m5.q: Chen ___ the umbrella properly — look at all the water sitting in it.
m5.why: 对过去的否定推测用 can't have done——他刚才一定没把伞撑好。

m5.q: Before he left, Wen said he ___ back before the gate was locked.
m5.why: 主句是过去时 said，宾语从句里的「将来」要退成过去将来 would be。

m5.q: If the rain ___ before noon, they would have reached the town before dark.
m5.why: 与过去事实相反的虚拟——从句用 had done，主句用 would have done。

m5.q: 下列四句中只有一句有语法错误。选出【错误】的一句：
ops: The wind was so cold that nobody spoke.
She is the girl whose bag was left behind.
Let's take the short way, will we?
That is the shelf on which the box stood.
m5.why: Let's 开头的祈使句，反意部分固定用 shall we。

m5.q: 下列四句中只有一句有语法错误。选出【错误】的一句：
ops: They have been waiting outside for an hour.
She promised she would call before noon.
He can't have forgot his own birthday.
The letters posted last week never arrived.
m5.why: 情态动词完成式要用过去分词 → can't have forgotten。
